codex.label: Codex
codex.//: OpenAI Codex through @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp (which bundles the Codex CLI).
codex.//login: ChatGPT sign-in needs a browser on the same machine, so it runs the Codex CLI's device-code flow in the login terminal. ChatGPT may ask you to allow device-code sign-in in its security settings first.

loginMethods.name: Sign in with ChatGPT
loginMethods.description: Opens the Codex sign-in: visit the link it shows and enter the code.

codex.//commands: Codex's /init would overwrite the generated AGENTS.md, and its review commands are for code.
